puzzle.words_ru.name: Lexicon
puzzle.words_ru.rule.1: Find the hidden Russian word before your guesses run out.
puzzle.words_ru.rule.alphabet: These puzzles use Russian words. Е and Ё count as the same letter; the board writes Е.
puzzle.words_ru.keyboard: Type Russian letters; Enter submits a guess, Backspace removes a letter. Е and Ё are equivalent.
puzzle.words_ru.tutorial.1: The hidden word is Russian. In ЛАМПА, А is green: it is in the right place. Л and М are amber: they belong elsewhere.
puzzle.words_ru.tutorial.2: П is absent. The second А is grey too: the answer has only one А, already marked green. Each copy is counted separately.
puzzle.words_ru.tutorial.3: Try САЛОН and press Enter. Any real word is allowed, even a probe that cannot itself be the answer.
puzzle.words_ru.tutorial.done: The marks give more information without spending a life: there are only guesses.
puzzle.words_ru.tutorial.play: Your turn: find the word from the marks. A hint can explain a deduction or give a Russian clue without typing the answer.
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.name: Word Wheel
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.tagline: Russian words from a circle of letters
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.keyboard: Type Russian letters, Enter submits, Backspace removes a letter, Escape clears. Е and Ё are equivalent.
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.tutorial.1: Spell Russian words using each wheel tile at most once. The crossing slots share letters. Fill every slot to finish.
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.tutorial.2: Trace САЛОН on the wheel, then submit it. You can also tap letters or type on a Russian keyboard.
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.tutorial.done: Its letters now help with the three crossing words.
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.tutorial.3: Try САЛО. It is a real Russian word, but this grid has no slot for it, so it is a bonus.
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.tutorial.bonus_done: Bonus words are recorded; only the grid words are required.
puzzle.wordwheel_ru.tutorial.play: Finish the crossing words. A letter shown by a crossing narrows the public word list; hints explain that reasoning.
puzzle.dwindle_ru.name: Dwindle
puzzle.dwindle_ru.tagline: Russian words that clear the tiles
puzzle.dwindle_ru.tutorial.1: Trace Russian words through tiles touching by a side. The three goals use every tile. A tile disappears only when no unfinished goal needs it.
puzzle.dwindle_ru.tutorial.2: First try ПИЛА: П → И → Л → А. It is a bonus word, not one of the three goals.
puzzle.dwindle_ru.tutorial.bonus_done: A bonus word is recorded but does not remove any tiles.
puzzle.dwindle_ru.tutorial.3: Now enter СИЛА. И and Л disappear; С and А stay because other goals still use them.
puzzle.dwindle_ru.tutorial.done: Shared tiles wait for every goal that uses them. The order of finding goals cannot leave you stuck.
puzzle.dwindle_ru.tutorial.play: Find the remaining two goals. Each has exactly one path, and hints reason from the live letters and the public Russian word list.
puzzle.hexwords_ru.name: Hexwords
puzzle.hexwords_ru.tagline: Russian words to reach the target
puzzle.hexwords_ru.keyboard: Type Russian letters; Enter submits, Tab changes the path, Backspace removes a letter, Escape clears.
puzzle.hexwords_ru.tutorial.1: Trace a Russian word through touching hexes. Its letters disappear. Three letters score 3, four score 5, five score 8; reach 11 here.
puzzle.hexwords_ru.tutorial.2: Take КОТ along the top row for 3 points. Choose the path carefully: each tile can be spent only once.
puzzle.hexwords_ru.tutorial.retry: Trace КОТ along the top row, then submit it.
puzzle.hexwords_ru.tutorial.done: Those three tiles are gone. You need 8 more points.
puzzle.hexwords_ru.tutorial.play: Reach the target with the remaining Russian words. Longer words score more; Undo lets you try a different choice.
